description: This file implements functions for a Service Logic Aggregation Plane component, specifically for retrieving object properties and method descriptors associated with an object entity in the SLAP framework. It includes two primary functions that interface with internal object methods, facilitating property and method descriptor access.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapOeoOlaGetObjectProperty(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * property_name)
methods.description: Retrieves the object property matching the provided property name by delegating to the object's internal GetObjectProperty function.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE SlapOeoOlaGetMethodDescriptor(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,char * method_name,SLAP_PARAMETER_LIST * param_list_input)
methods.description: Retrieves the method descriptor matching the provided method name and input parameter list by delegating to the object's internal GetMethodDescriptor2 function.
